subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should ClickClack JSON REST operations fail closed after a fixed 30 seconds while multipart uploads retain no completion deadline?
rationale: Tests establish that the implementation works, but they cannot determine the acceptable ClickClack service latency or whether indefinitely waiting uploads are an intentional product boundary.

options.title: Approve the current policy
options.body: Confirm the owner-local 30-second JSON deadline and multipart exception, refresh onto current main, rerun focused validation, and merge.

options.title: Retune before merge
options.body: Choose a different JSON deadline or add a separate upload deadline, then update the focused tests and runtime proof to match.

recommendation.title: Approve the current policy
recommendation.body: Confirm the owner-local 30-second JSON deadline and multipart exception, refresh onto current main, rerun focused validation, and merge.
